en.hubeali:
And from him, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5th or 6th Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:
‘The divorced woman inherits and is inherited (from) until she sees the third blood. So when she sees it, so she is cut-off’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Safwan from ibn Muskan from Zurarah who has said the following: “About the case of a woman who is divorced, one of the two Imam, (abu Ja‘far or abu ‘Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam, has said, ‘
She inherits and is inherited until she sees blood of Hayd (menses) for the third time after divorce and when that happens it (such relation) is cut off.’”
